intervals.note: Start is the date the DRIFT experiment became operational at Boulby, used for the collaboration (its own formation date is not published in the sources read). No source read after the 2017 paper states whether the collaboration is still operating DRIFT.
intervals.quote: The DRIFT experiment has been operational at the Boulby Underground Laboratory in the UK since 2001

name: DRIFT Collaboration
notes: Roster not published in the sources read. Current activity is unconfirmed (latest paper read: arXiv:1701.00171, 2017).

summary.plain: The UK-US team that develops and operates the DRIFT directional dark matter detectors in the Boulby mine, which try to see which direction a dark matter particle came from.
summary.technical: DRIFT (Directional Recoil Identification From Tracks) Collaboration: UK and US institutions operating low-pressure negative-ion CS2 time projection chambers at the Boulby Underground Laboratory since 2001 (1110.0222).
